summary: A Yes vote amends the Los Angeles County Charter to prohibit strikes by certified public safety employees and their supervisors, reiterate good-faith negotiation obligations, and establish an impartial binding arbitration process for resolving their labor disputes.

wages.text: A Yes vote requires binding arbitration for labor disputes involving Los Angeles County certified public safety employees.
wages.quote: Measure A - Charter Amendment Requiring Binding Arbitration for Labor Disputes with Los Angeles County Certified Public Safety Employees

wages.text: A No vote does not adopt this charter amendment requiring binding arbitration.
